# Economics 101

> A free, self-paced four-week economics course covering scarcity, opportunity cost, supply and demand, markets, policy, trade, and growth.

Canonical home: https://finance101.xyz/

## Course weeks

- [Week 1 — Foundations of choice and markets](https://finance101.xyz/weeks/1)
- [Week 2 — Firms, consumers, and market structure](https://finance101.xyz/weeks/2)
- [Week 3 — Macroeconomics and policy](https://finance101.xyz/weeks/3)
- [Week 4 — Trade, development, and institutions](https://finance101.xyz/weeks/4)

Individual lectures are available beneath `https://finance101.xyz/lectures/{id}`, where `{id}` is the lecture identifier.

For the complete inventory of course pages, see the [XML sitemap](https://finance101.xyz/sitemap.xml).
